about_short_description.short_description: Supersonik provides an AI-powered platform for SaaS companies to offer 24/7 interactive product demos.

product.name: Supersonik
product.description: An AI-powered live product experience platform that conducts interactive software demonstrations inside a company’s product or through a shared link, allowing customers to explore features and complete actions in real time.

product.name: Supersonik for Presales
product.description: An AI presales solution that gives inbound prospects interactive, personalized product demonstrations on demand through a website, application, or shared link.

product.name: Supersonik for Onboarding
product.description: An AI onboarding service that gives new customers live, personalized product walkthroughs and continues guiding them through later sessions until they reach key activation milestones.

product.name: Supersonik for Customer Support
product.description: An AI customer support service that answers product questions through live, in-product walkthroughs, updates helpdesk records, and escalates complex issues with conversation context.
